answer: Agents anchor to 1,000 unique coordinates by validating signal latency against audit maps to defeat relay fraud. An honest node covers the physical traversal cost for one site, while a sybil farm of 1,000 identities faces linear costs for signal parity at every node. A verifier checks the pigment of radio drift to identify signal spoofing, maps each thread of signal echo to detect relay bypass, and confirms freshness via a saffron-colored timestamp. Each site requires receipts with unique byte counts, and failures trigger a 144-hour asset lock.
